e.title: AIDA（国际保险法协会）：区域分组、工作组、国别分会与青年 AIDA
e.title_en: AIDA: regional groupings, working parties, national sections and Young AIDA for insurance law
e.title_hk: AIDA（國際保險法協會）：區域分組、工作組、國別分會與青年 AIDA
e.summary: 保险法领域的国际协会：以区域分组、工作组与国别分会三层结构组织成员，设 Young AIDA 面向青年从业者，并公开章程、治理结构与历期通讯
e.summary_en: An international association in the field of insurance law: it organises members through a three-tier structure of regional groupings, working parties and national sections, runs Young AIDA for early-career practitioners, and publishes its by-laws, governance structure and newsletters
e.summary_hk: 保險法領域的國際協會：以區域分組、工作組與國別分會三層結構組織成員，設 Young AIDA 面向青年從業者，並公開章程、治理結構與歷期通訊
e.body:
**AIDA** 是**保险法（insurance law）领域的国际协会**（站点标题实测仅为 **「Home Page | AIDA」**）。本条目补的是**「按专业（法律）组织的国际保险协会」这一形态**——**实测池内「保险法/监管法」此前仅 2 条**（[[taiwan-insurance-bureau]] 与 [[rim534]]，**两条都不是国际法学组织**），**而「以学科/专业为纽带、横跨各国分会的国际协会」此前为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 42.4KB（43,429 字节），标题「Home Page | AIDA」**；⭐ **「Working Parties（工作组）」页 `/working-parties` 实测 50.5KB**；⭐ **「National Sections（国别分会）」页 `/national-sections` 实测 50.3KB**；⭐ **「Regional Groupings（区域分组）」页 `/regional-groupings` 实测 43.8KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的三层组织结构**：**Secondary Menu** 含 ⭐ **Regional Groupings**、⭐ **Working Parties**、⭐ **National Sections**、**ARIAS Societies**、⭐ **Young AIDA**；**Main navigation** 含 **About AIDA**（**Overview**、**Objectives**、**Activities**、**Governance & Structure**、⭐ **AIDA By-laws（章程）**、**AIDA History**、⭐ **AIDA Medal Holders**）、**Young AIDA**、**Join AIDA!**、**Events/Meetings**（**Forthcoming**、**All**）、**People**、⭐ **Newsletters**、**Contact us**。**正文实测的一则动态**：**「AIDA Argentina has published the 10th issue of its Institutional Journal」**（**阿根廷分会已出版其机构期刊第 10 期**）——**说明国别分会自行出版刊物**。**链接实测另见** `/about-aida/structure-governance`、`/about-aida/aida-by-laws`、`/about-aida/young-aida`、`/aida-people`、`/newsletters`，以及一期通讯 `/news/june-2026-newsletter-2026-06-11`（**2026 年 6 月**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保险法的国际专业网络」这一层**——**本轮四条恰好构成四种不同的国际协作组织逻辑**：**[[iais]] 按标准职能**、**[[assal]] 按地域（拉美监管者）**、**[[sif]] 按议题（可持续）**、**AIDA 按专业分支（保险法）**；**对做保险法与监管比较的学生，AIDA 是把「各国保险法研究者与实务者」连接起来的那一层**（**注意：本词条不主张四者之间有任何隶属关系**）。**② ⭐ 「区域分组 / 工作组 / 国别分会」三层是国际学术-专业协会的典型结构，且三层各有明确职能**——**区域分组按地理聚合（实测含欧洲分组）、工作组按专题（保险法下的具体课题）、国别分会按国家**；**这与池内 [[aae]]（欧洲精算协会伞状）、[[fuedi]]（欧洲公估协会伞状）的「区域伞状」不同——AIDA 是**跨大洲的三维矩阵**（地理 × 专题 × 国家）**（**注意：本次未打开三层各自的具体内容，故不转述其数量与名单**）。**③ ⭐ 「Young AIDA」与同轮其他条目形成呼应**——**池内已有 [[clm]] 的「青年专业者顾问委员会」、[[iaj]] 的「合格者经验」等面向新入行的设计**，**AIDA 的 Young AIDA 是同一思路在法学界的版本**；**对本站读者（学生），这是一个可参与的入口**（**本次未打开其内容与加入条件**）。**④ 「AIDA Medal Holders」是一个少见机制**——**协会设奖章并公开得主名单**，**与 [[iais]] 的「Distinguished Fellows」同属「行业组织向个人授予荣誉」的做法**（**本次未打开名单**）。**⑤ 章程（By-laws）与治理结构公开**——**一个国际协会把组织法公开**，**对研究「国际专业组织如何治理」的学生是可用的样本**（**本次未打开章程文本**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的三层组织结构与全部主栏目、一则国别分会刊物的动态、以及若干子页与一期通讯的路径**，**但未打开章程文本、治理结构页、任何工作组或区域分组内容、任何国别分会内容、Young AIDA 的具体安排、奖章得主名单或任何一期通讯**，因此**不能转述章程条款、工作组与分会的名称与数量、治理细节、奖章得主或通讯内容**；**② ⭐ 站点标题实测仅为「Home Page | AIDA」**——**页面本身未给出该缩写的正式全称**，**故本词条不主张其英文/法文全称的官方展开**（**词条内仅以「AIDA」与「保险法领域的国际协会」表述**）；**③ ⚠️ 一个易混点必须写明**：**AIDA 站点另有一个名为「CILA」的区域分组路径**，**它与第 312 轮收录的 [[cila]]（英国特许公估师学会 Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters）不是同一机构**——**本词条因此不对该分组作 wikilink，也不转述其内容**；**④ 「区域分组含欧洲分组」来自实测的 `/regional-groupings/aida-europe` 路径**，**其余区域分组本次未逐一核实**；**⑤ ARIAS Societies 的性质（是否与仲裁/再保险有关）本次未核实**，**故词条内仅列出其作为导航条目**；**⑥ 该协会的成立年份、秘书处所在地、成员规模与法定地位本次未核实**；**⑦ 站点未实测到多语切换**（**名称含法语渊源但页面为英文，法语版本情况未核实**）；**⑧** 本词条**不主张** AIDA 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：首页（42.4KB）、`/working-parties`（50.5KB）、`/national-sections`（50.3KB）、`/regional-groupings`（43.8KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开章程、治理结构、工作组、区域分组、国别分会、Young AIDA、奖章名单或通讯**。
e.body_en:
**AIDA** is **an international association in the field of insurance law** (measured site title only **"Home Page | AIDA"**). This entry adds the **"international insurance association organised by profession (law)"** form — **measured: "insurance law / regulatory law" previously held only two entries** ([[taiwan-insurance-bureau]] and [[rim534]], **neither an international legal body**), **while an international association spanning national chapters and bound by a discipline was at zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 42.4KB (43,429 bytes) with the measured title "Home Page | AIDA"**; ⭐ the **"Working Parties" page measures 50.5KB**; ⭐ the **"National Sections" page measures 50.3KB**; ⭐ the **"Regional Groupings" page measures 43.8KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals a three-tier organisational structure**: the **Secondary Menu** carries ⭐ **Regional Groupings**, ⭐ **Working Parties**, ⭐ **National Sections**, **ARIAS Societies** and ⭐ **Young AIDA**; the **Main navigation** carries **About AIDA** (**Overview**, **Objectives**, **Activities**, **Governance & Structure**, ⭐ **AIDA By-laws**, **AIDA History**, ⭐ **AIDA Medal Holders**), **Young AIDA**, **Join AIDA!**, **Events/Meetings** (**Forthcoming**, **All**), **People**, ⭐ **Newsletters** and **Contact us**. **One measured news item**: **"AIDA Argentina has published the 10th issue of its Institutional Journal"** — **showing national sections publishing their own journals**. **Measured links also include** `/about-aida/structure-governance`, `/about-aida/aida-by-laws`, `/about-aida/young-aida`, `/aida-people`, `/newsletters` and a newsletter issue at `/news/june-2026-newsletter-2026-06-11` (**June 2026**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the international professional network for insurance law** — **this round’s four entries happen to give four different organising logics for international cooperation**: **[[iais]] by standard-setting function**, **[[assal]] by geography (Latin American supervisors)**, **[[sif]] by topic (sustainability)** and **AIDA by professional discipline (insurance law)**; **for work on insurance law and comparative regulation, AIDA is the layer connecting insurance-law scholars and practitioners across countries** (**note: this entry claims no affiliation among the four**). **② ⭐ The regional groupings / working parties / national sections three-tier structure is typical of international academic-professional associations, with a distinct function at each tier** — **regional groupings aggregate geographically (a Europe grouping is measured), working parties by subject, national sections by country**; **this differs from the "regional umbrella" of [[aae]] (European actuaries) and [[fuedi]] (European adjusters) — AIDA is a transcontinental matrix of geography × subject × country** (**note: the content of each tier was not opened, so no counts or rosters are restated**). **③ ⭐ "Young AIDA" echoes other entries in the same round** — **the corpus already has the Young Professionals Advisory Board at [[clm]] and the candidate-experience section of [[iaj]] aimed at new entrants**, **and Young AIDA is the legal profession’s version of the same idea**; **for this wiki’s student readers, it is a participation route** (**its content and joining conditions were not opened**). **④ "AIDA Medal Holders" is an uncommon mechanism** — **an association awarding medals and publishing the list of holders**, **belonging with [[iais]]’s "Distinguished Fellows" as "trade bodies granting individual honours"** (**the list was not opened**). **⑤ The by-laws and governance structure are public** — **an international association publishing its own constitution**, **usable material for students studying how international professional organisations govern themselves** (**the by-laws text was not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the three-tier organisational structure and all main navigation items read verbatim, one news item about a national section’s journal, and several subpage and newsletter issue paths**, **but opened no by-laws text, no governance page, no working party or regional grouping content, no national section content, no Young AIDA arrangements, no medal holder list and no newsletter issue**, so **no by-law clause, working party or section name or count, governance detail, medal holder or newsletter content can be restated**; **② ⭐ the measured site title is only "Home Page | AIDA"** — **the page itself gives no formal expansion of the acronym**, **so this entry does not assert an official English or French expansion** (**it uses only "AIDA" and "an international association in the field of insurance law"**); **③ ⚠️ A confusion risk must be stated**: **the AIDA site carries a regional grouping path named "CILA"**, **which is not the same body as [[cila]] added in round 312 (the Chartered Institute of Loss Adjusters)** — **this entry therefore makes no wikilink to that grouping and restates none of its content**; **④ "a Europe grouping is measured" comes from the measured `/regional-groupings/aida-europe` path**, **and the other regional groupings were not verified one by one**; **⑤ the nature of ARIAS Societies (whether arbitration or reinsurance related) was not verified**, **so the entry lists it only as a navigation item**; **⑥ the association’s founding year, secretariat location, membership size and legal status were not verified**; **⑦ no language switch was measured** (**the name has a French lineage but the pages are English; the French version was not verified**); **⑧** this entry **does not claim AIDA provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: the homepage (42.4KB), `/working-parties` (50.5KB), `/national-sections` (50.3KB) and `/regional-groupings` (43.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no by-laws, governance page, working party, regional grouping, national section, Young AIDA, medal list or newsletter was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**AIDA** 是**保險法（insurance law）領域的國際協會**（站點標題實測僅為 **「Home Page | AIDA」**）。本條目補的是**「按專業（法律）組織的國際保險協會」這一形態**——**實測池內「保險法/監管法」此前僅 2 條**（[[taiwan-insurance-bureau]] 與 [[rim534]]，**兩條都不是國際法學組織**），**而「以學科／專業為紐帶、橫跨各國分會的國際協會」此前為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 42.4KB，標題「Home Page | AIDA」**；⭐ **「Working Parties（工作組）」頁 50.5KB**；⭐ **「National Sections（國別分會）」頁 50.3KB**；⭐ **「Regional Groupings（區域分組）」頁 43.8KB**。**導航逐字實測的三層結構**：**Secondary Menu** 含 ⭐**Regional Groupings／Working Parties／National Sections／ARIAS Societies／⭐Young AIDA**；**Main navigation** 含 **About AIDA**（Overview／Objectives／Activities／Governance & Structure／⭐**AIDA By-laws（章程）**／AIDA History／⭐**AIDA Medal Holders**）、**Young AIDA**、**Join AIDA!**、**Events/Meetings**、**People**、⭐**Newsletters**、**Contact us**。**正文實測一則動態**：**「AIDA Argentina has published the 10th issue of its Institutional Journal」**——**說明國別分會自行出版刊物**。**連結實測另見** `/about-aida/structure-governance`、`/about-aida/aida-by-laws`、`/about-aida/young-aida`、`/aida-people`、`/newsletters`，以及一期通訊 `/news/june-2026-newsletter-2026-06-11`（**2026 年 6 月**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保險法的國際專業網絡」**——**本輪四條恰好構成四種不同組織邏輯**：**[[iais]] 按標準職能／[[assal]] 按地域／[[sif]] 按議題／AIDA 按專業分支（保險法）**（**不主張四者隸屬關係**）。**② ⭐ 「區域分組／工作組／國別分會」三層是國際學術-專業協會的典型結構**——**與 [[aae]]、[[fuedi]] 的「區域傘狀」不同，AIDA 是**跨大洲的三維矩陣**（地理 × 專題 × 國家）**（**三層具體內容本次未打開，故不轉述數量與名單**）。**③ ⭐ 「Young AIDA」與同輪其他條目呼應**——**池內已有 [[clm]] 的青年專業者顧問委員會、[[iaj]] 的合格者經驗等面向新入行的設計**，**Young AIDA 是同一思路在法學界的版本**（**未打開其內容與加入條件**）。**④ 「AIDA Medal Holders」是少見機制**——**與 [[iais]] 的「Distinguished Fellows」同屬「行業組織向個人授予榮譽」**（**未打開名單**）。**⑤ 章程與治理結構公開**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的三層結構與全部主欄目、一則國別分會刊物動態、以及若干子頁與一期通訊路徑**，**但未打開章程文本、治理結構頁、任何工作組或區域分組內容、任何國別分會內容、Young AIDA 安排、獎章名單或任何一期通訊**，故**不能轉述章程條款、工作組與分會名稱與數量、治理細節、獎章得主或通訊內容**；**② ⭐ 站點標題實測僅為「Home Page | AIDA」**——**未給出正式全稱**，**故不主張其英文／法文全稱的官方展開**；**③ ⚠️ 一個易混點必須寫明**：**AIDA 站點另有一個名為「CILA」的區域分組路徑**，**它與第 312 輪收錄的 [[cila]]（英國特許公估師學會）不是同一機構**——**本詞條因此不對該分組作 wikilink，也不轉述其內容**；**④ 「含歐洲分組」來自實測的 `/regional-groupings/aida-europe` 路徑**，**其餘區域分組未逐一核實**；**⑤ ARIAS Societies 的性質未核實**；**⑥ 成立年份、秘書處所在地、成員規模與法定地位未核實**；**⑦ 未實測到多語切換**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張** AIDA 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開章程、治理結構、工作組、區域分組、國別分會、Young AIDA、獎章名單或通訊**。
